in_sanskrit.name: अरवीप्देप
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Radiant and deep as the Aravīn river

in_hindi.name: Aravdeep
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Deep Arav
in_hindi.long_meaning: Aravdeep एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Arav (Arava) is the name of a tree which symbolizes the deep and enlightening wisdom. Deep refers to the profoundness of the knowledge that Arav embodies. The name Aravdeep thus signifies the deep wisdom, the inner light of knowledge and enlightenment.
